issue.title: Bank UI e2e walk-learn getLine(-1) then walk-real-key-swallowed does not open
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-lt.land while landing epic bob-cli-lt. Not caused by the landing-tale edits: the same failures reproduce on clean bob-plugins HEAD 99e3410. `walk-card-layout` passes immediately before this cluster.

## What fails

`scripts/obsidian-bank-ui-e2e.cjs` records:

- `walk-learn-coffee` FAIL: `RangeError: Invalid line number 0 in 15-line document` from `editor.getLine(lineOf("$6.45 Corner Cafe"))` after dispatching `c` with the Category card open. `lineOf` is `findIndex` and returns -1 when the payee line is missing, which CodeMirror reports as line 0.
- `walk-learn-accept` FAIL: same evaluate.
- `walk-real-key-swallowed` FAIL: `{opened:false}` after the previous error; the December note never opens a Category card.

Earlier walk cases on the November fixture (`walk-ctrl-enter-c` through `walk-undo`) pass.

## Repro

```
xvfb-run -a env BOB_BIN=/home/bryan/.cargo/bin/bob TMPDIR=/tmp/bse2e \
  node scripts/obsidian-bank-ui-e2e.cjs \
  -e /snap/obsidian/current/app/obsidian \
  -o /tmp/bank-ui-e2e-out -r /tmp/bank-ui-e2e-out/report.json
```

Identical on the land tree and on clean 99e3410.

## CI failure

- **Node:** `scripts/obsidian-bank-ui-e2e.cjs walk-learn-coffee`
